meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 把一份文档交给它,它会用 NotebookLM 生成 kawaii 风格的幻灯片 PDF,再上传到 WOWerpoint Server 换成一个竖版手机的分享链接。
howto.when: 当你提到 “wowerpoint this”、“make a deck about <file>” 等说法,或要把一份文档做成可分享的叙事幻灯片时触发。

say.note: 生成幻灯片 PDF,再给出手机版分享链接

say.text: 把这份报告做成幻灯片
say.note: 标题取文档 H1,输出同目录的 -slides.pdf

say.text: 用 kawaii 角色讲这个故事,做成幻灯片
say.note: 你给的提示词会原样传给生成环节

howto.what_en: Hand it one document and it produces a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF, then uploads it to the WOWerpoint Server, which returns a 9:16 mobile share link.
howto.when_en: Triggered by "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", or any request to turn a single document into shareable narrative slides.

say_en.note: Builds the slide-deck PDF and returns a mobile share link
Title comes from the doc's H1; writes <stem>-slides.pdf

say_en.text: Use kawaii characters to tell this story as slides
say_en.note: Your prompt is passed through verbatim
